name: Build Daily Recipes
fail: A menu dish has no recipe; a recipe scales a diet variant to the full {{residents}} instead of its share, or multiplies the serving size by the headcount; a recipe is missing batch yield / critical temps / hold temps; or it departs from the menu — wrong diet, wrong texture, a substituted dish, or a swapped ingredient.
pass: Every dish on the day's menu has a complete recipe: a normal single-serving portion, a batch that yields only that diet's share of ~{{residents}} residents (plus a small buffer) with ingredient totals scaled to that batch, prep and service steps, HACCP critical temps, and hold temps. Across a meal's diet variants the portions sum to about {{residents}}, not {{residents}} each. Each recipe matches the dish the menu specified — same diet and texture.
instruction:
Write every kitchen recipe needed for day {{day}} ({{weekday (date day)}}, {{date day}}). The day's full menu is provided as context above — it already settles which dishes to cook and has applied diet, season, texture, and restriction rules. Produce one complete recipe for each distinct dish on it (all meals), exactly as specified — same dish, same diet, same texture; do not substitute, re-season, or swap ingredients.

Portioning — about {{residents}} residents eat each meal in TOTAL, split across the diet variants. Distribute that headcount across the diets by their typical statistical share, then add a small buffer. Each recipe's batch yields only ITS diet's slice — never the full {{residents}}; all variants of one meal sum to roughly {{residents}} (+ buffer). Set a normal single-serving portion (e.g. 1 cup of a casserole; a side salad with ~¼ cup tomatoes) and scale only the INGREDIENT totals up to that batch's portion count — never multiply the serving size by the headcount.

Where dishes share components, reuse the same prep so the order list stays tight. Cost tier: {{costTier}}.

name: Build Seasonal Menus
fail: A missing meal, a diet not honored, a legal/safety or budget violation, an out-of-season item{{#if flags.pureed}}, or a dish with an ingredient that can't go in a blender{{/if}}.
pass: Day {{day}} covers {{join meals ", "}}; every diet ({{join diets ", "}}) is honored; within the context's legal/safety limits and the {{costTier}} budget; in season for {{season (date day)}}{{#if flags.pureed}}; every dish made only of blendable ingredients{{/if}}.

name: Build Inventory
fail: An ingredient from day {{day}}'s recipes has no row.
pass: Every ingredient from day {{day}}'s recipes appears as a row with a serving quantity.
instruction:
This is day {{day}} for {{residents}} residents with {{count diets}} diets, distribution: {{#each (allocate diets residents) as |d|}}{{d.diet}} {{d.pct}}%{{#unless @last}}, {{/unless}}{{/each}}.

Please do the following conversion when there is no measurable amount — "to taste", "a pinch", "a smidgen", or the equivalent in ANY language → amount 0.25, unit "tsp".

name: Fetch Legal
fail: Rules are missing the codes, rules are fabricated, codes do not match with content, rule is a heading and not actual codes or RULES that can be followed, there is other content besides just the rules.
pass: Must have a bare bulleted list with the rules followed by the code, rules are documented, rules are the specification, and can be measured through verification.
instruction:
Please get all of the rules for {{#eq Institution 1}}a{{/eq}} "{{join Institution ", "}}" facilit{{#ne Institution 1}}ies{{/ne}}{{#eq Institution 1}}y{{/eq}} dietary restrictions, food preparation, cooking, handling, sanitation, storage, and temperature requirements for {{legal}}.

Please output as a bullet list with no narrative, commentary, or otherwise.

Each rule should be on a line by itself with the related code.
